products.name: EUROPYA 40 LTR Planetary Mixer
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND 40 LTR PLANETARY MIXER BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: 40 litre bowl planetary mixer with three speeds, oil bath gear box and hook, whip and beater attachments.
products.description: The EUROPYA 40 LTR Planetary Mixer is a commercial-grade mixing machine built for bakeries and large production kitchens. It runs a high quality transmission gear and belt drive with an oil bath gear box for sustained heavy-duty operation, and ships with hook, whip and beater attachments to cover dough, cream and batter work. A safety guard protects the operator during mixing. Supplied with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: EUROPYA 30 LTR Planetary Mixer
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND 30 LTR PLANETARY MIXER BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: 30 litre semi-automatic planetary mixer with three speeds and oil bath gear box for bakery production.
products.description: The EUROPYA 30 LTR Planetary Mixer is a semi-automatic commercial mixer sized for mid-volume bakeries. High quality transmission gear and belt drive, three speed and three function operation and an oil bath gear box deliver reliable performance through long production runs. Supplied with hook, whip and beater attachments and a safety guard, backed by 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: EUROPYA 20 LTR Planetary Mixer
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND 20 LTR PLANETARY MIXER BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: 20 litre commercial planetary mixer with three speed operation and complete attachment set.
products.description: The EUROPYA 20 LTR Planetary Mixer suits bakeries, cafes and restaurant kitchens that need dependable daily mixing capacity. It features a high quality transmission gear and belt, three speed and three function control, an oil bath gear box and a high quality motor. Hook, whip and beater attachments and a safety guard are included, with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: EUROPYA 10 LTR Planetary Mixer
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND 10 LTR PLANETARY MIXER BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: Compact 10 litre planetary mixer for cafes, pastry shops and small bakery kitchens.
products.description: The EUROPYA 10 LTR Planetary Mixer is the compact entry in the EUROPYA planetary range, suited to pastry shops, cafes and small bakery operations. It carries the same high quality transmission gear and belt, three speed and three function operation and oil bath gear box as the larger models. Hook, whip and beater attachments and a safety guard are included, with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: BCARE 100 LTR Planetary Mixer
products.indiamartName: BCARE BRAND 100 LTR PLANETARY MIXER BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: 100 litre heavy-duty planetary mixer for industrial bakery and central production kitchens.
products.description: The BCARE 100 LTR Planetary Mixer is the largest planetary mixer in the BCare range, built for industrial bakeries and central production facilities. Heavy-duty transmission gear and belt drive, an oil bath gear box and a high quality motor handle continuous large-batch mixing. Three speed and three function operation with hook, whip and beater attachments and a safety guard. Supplied with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: BCARE 60 LTR Planetary Mixer
products.indiamartName: BCARE BRAND 60 LTR PLANETARY MIXER BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: 60 litre heavy-duty planetary mixer for high-volume bakery production.
products.description: The BCARE 60 LTR Planetary Mixer bridges mid and industrial scale bakery production. It combines a high quality transmission gear and belt with an oil bath gear box and high quality motor for sustained heavy mixing loads. Three speed and three function operation, hook, whip and beater attachments and a safety guard are standard. Supplied with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: EUROPYA 7 LTR Fresh Cream Mixer
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND 7 LTR FRESH CREAM MIXER BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: 7 litre fresh cream mixer for whipping cream, icing and light batter work.
products.description: The EUROPYA 7 LTR Fresh Cream Mixer is a compact planetary-action machine dedicated to whipping fresh cream, icing and light batters. Three speed and three function operation with an oil bath gear box and high quality motor gives consistent aeration without over-working the cream. Hook, whip and beater attachments and a safety guard are included, with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: EUROPYA Spiral Mixer 8 KG Flour
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND SPIRAL MIXER 8 FLOUR BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: Stainless steel fixed-bowl automatic spiral mixer rated for 8 kg flour batches.
products.description: The EUROPYA Spiral Mixer 8 KG is a stainless steel fixed-bowl spiral mixer built for bread and bun dough. The spiral hook develops gluten efficiently while keeping dough temperature low, producing consistent, well-aerated dough. Automatic operation with a high quality transmission gear and belt, oil bath gear box and safety guard. Supplied with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: EUROPYA Spiral Mixer 12 KG Flour
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND SPIRAL MIXER 12 FLOUR BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: ISO certified stainless steel spiral mixer for 12 kg flour batches in hotels and restaurants.
products.description: The EUROPYA Spiral Mixer 12 KG is an ISO certified stainless steel fixed-bowl spiral mixer for hotel, restaurant and bakery bread production. Automatic spiral action develops gluten thoroughly while minimising friction heat. Built with a high quality transmission gear and belt, oil bath gear box and safety guard. Supplied with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: EUROPYA Spiral Mixer 25 KG Flour
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND SPIRAL MIXER 25 FLOUR BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: Stainless steel automatic spiral mixer rated for 25 kg flour batches.
products.description: The EUROPYA Spiral Mixer 25 KG handles substantial bread dough batches for hotels, restaurants and production bakeries. The stainless steel fixed bowl and spiral hook deliver thorough, low-temperature gluten development batch after batch. Automatic operation with high quality transmission gear and belt, oil bath gear box and safety guard. Supplied with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: EUROPYA Spiral Mixer 50 KG Flour
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND SPIRAL MIXER 50 FLOUR BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: Heavy-duty stainless steel spiral mixer for 50 kg flour batches in production bakeries.

High quality transmission gear and belt, oil bath gear box and safety guard. Supplied with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: 100 KG Spiral Mixer

Stainless steel construction with a heavy-duty spiral hook develops very large dough batches evenly and efficiently. High quality transmission gear and belt, oil bath gear box and safety guard. Supplied with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: Automatic Dough Kneader
products.indiamartName: Automatic Dough Kneader

Our dough kneader takes lesser time and gives better water absorption and also folds and stretches the dough for aeration and fermentation. It features a stainless steel bowl, which moves at a slow speed.

products.name: EUROPYA 2 Deck 4 Tray Automatic Gas Oven
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND 2 DECK 4 TRAY AUTOMATIC GAS OVEN BCARE BAKERY & EQUIPMENTS

CE certified with automatic gas operation for high baking quality and low fuel consumption. Supplied with 1 year warranty across Pan India.

products.description: Beautiful and strong handle, more attractive and improve the oven grade. Equipped with overheat protector, power supply would cut off automatically when over temperature, more reliable and safe. Fast heating, up to 200 ºC within 12 minutes. 10 year warranty for elements.

products.name: EUROPYA 3 Deck 9 Tray Automatic Gas Oven

CE certified with automatic gas operation for high baking quality and low fuel consumption at industrial scale. Supplied with 1 year warranty across Pan India.

products.name: Single Trolley Rotary Rack Oven
products.indiamartName: Single Trolley Rotary Rack Oven
products.shortDescription: Stainless steel single trolley rotary rack oven with 60 minute timer and 1 year warranty.
products.description: Rotary rack oven is essentially a convection oven with removable trolley racks. Air is heated by burning fuel in a chamber. Fuel can be diesel (most popular), LPG, wood, coal and electric. Air is heated by blowing air on chamber, using a centrifugal blower.

products.name: EUROPYA Dough Sheeter
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA DOUGH SHEETER
products.shortDescription: CE certified stainless steel dough sheeter for croissants and laminated pastry.
products.description: The dough sheeter can perform a few functions that can be helpful for those who work in the food industry and industrial bakery. It can turn separate batches of dough into a continuous sheet. It can also laminate the layers together without the need for dividers and pocket proofers.

products.name: Bread Proofer Machine
products.indiamartName: Bread Proofer Machine
products.shortDescription: CE certified 12 tray stainless steel bread proofer with automatic operation.
products.description: A dough proofer is a warming chamber used in baking that encourages fermentation of dough by yeast through warm temperatures and controlled humidity. It is also called a proofing box, proofing oven, or proofing cabinet.

products.name: EUROPYA Hot Bread Slicer
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND HOT BREAD SLICER BCARE BAKERY AND KITCHEN EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: 31 blade hot bread slicer with 12 mm cutting thickness, 200-300 loaves per hour.
products.description: The EUROPYA Hot Bread Slicer slices bread while still warm, using 31 blades at a maximum cutting thickness of 12 mm to produce even slices at 200 to 300 loaves per hour. Built with a high quality transmission and high quality motor for continuous bakery use. Supplied with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: EUROPYA Hot Bread Slicer (Heavy Duty)
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BRAND HOT BREAD SLICER BCARE BAKERY AND KITCHEN EQUIPMENTS
products.shortDescription: Heavy duty hot bread slicer for continuous high-volume bakery slicing.
products.description: The heavy duty variant of the EUROPYA Hot Bread Slicer is built for bakeries slicing continuously through peak production. It uses the same hot-slicing blade system in a reinforced frame for higher throughput and longer duty cycles. Supplied with 1 year on-site warranty from BCare Bakery & Kitchen Equipments.

products.name: EUROPYA Icing Machine
products.indiamartName: Europya Icing Machine
products.shortDescription: CE certified stainless steel automatic icing machine with 1 year warranty.
products.description: The EUROPYA Icing Machine automates the preparation and application of icing for cakes and pastries. Stainless steel body construction meets food-contact hygiene requirements and simplifies cleaning between batches. CE certified with automatic operation and 1 year warranty.

products.name: EUROPYA Bread Toaster
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA BREAD TOASTER
products.shortDescription: ISI certified 4 slice bread toaster, 750 W, made in India.
products.description: A toaster is a compact kitchen appliance that specializes in making toasted breads, bagels and even some pastries quickly. Toasters have coils facing either side of the item, enabling them to deliver an even level of cooking to both sides. Toasters also feature slide-out crumb trays to make cleaning quick and easy.

products.name: EUROPYA Meat Mincer
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA MEAT MINCER
products.shortDescription: Automatic electric meat mincer with 150 kg per hour output capacity.
products.description: A meat grinder (also called a meat mincer in the UK) is a kitchen appliance for mincing (fine chopping) and mixing of raw or cooked meat, fish, vegetables or similar food. It replaces tools like the mincing knife, which are also used in the preparation of minced meat, filling, and similar products.

products.name: EUROPYA Meat Slicer
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA MEAT SLICER
products.shortDescription: Commercial electric meat slicer, 220-240 V, minimum order 1 piece.
products.description: A meat slicer, also called a slicing machine, deli slicer or simply a slicer, is a tool used in butcher shops and delicatessens to slice meats, sausages, cheeses and other deli products. As compared to a simple knife, using a meat slicer requires less effort, as well as keeps the texture of food more intact.

products.name: EUROPYA Vegetable Slicer (Imported)
products.indiamartName: EUROPYA VEGETABLE SLICER (IMPORTED)
products.shortDescription: Imported semi-automatic all-vegetable slicer for industrial food preparation.
products.description: The vegetable slicer machine has wide applications. It can cut potato, cucumber, apple and other vegetables and fruits into round or diagonal slices. The number, diameter, and angle of the feeding inlet can be customized. There is no restriction on the thickness of the vegetables or fruits.

products.name: Round Waffle Machine
products.indiamartName: Round Waffle Machine
products.shortDescription: 1180 W round waffle machine with 50-300°C range and 1 year warranty.
products.description: Waffle irons made of enameled cast aluminium, can be cleaned with a brush. The waffles measure 190 mm diameter and up to 23 mm thick. The temperature can be set steplessly between 50°C and 220°C. The timer can be set up to 15 minutes.

products.name: Coconut Scraper And Banana Slicer Machine
products.indiamartName: Coconut Scraper And Banana Slicer Machine
products.shortDescription: Stainless steel coconut scraper and banana slicer, 100 coconuts per hour, 1.5 kW.
products.description: The Coconut Scraper is exceptionally convenient to use for grating coconut. Make traditional South Indian coconut chutneys with this kitchen tool as you grate fresh coconuts. The machine combines coconut scraping and banana slicing in a single stainless steel unit built for commercial kitchens across Kerala.
